name: Polaroid Photo Dump
summary: Switch seventeen photos inside an instant-film frame on satin, one every two beats of a bundled CC0 track, with a slow zoom, film grade and editable caption.

compatibility.selects: Needs the editor's existing original Image placement service (same as Four Photo Reveal and Camera Shutter Dump), transparent PNG Image clips, public clip effects, motion graphics and Audio overlays; no Node.js. Verified in Selects Staging and a local develop build on 2026-09-30: saved Draft readback and FHD export. The Node-free panel (2026-10-01) passed its local tests but has not yet been run in the app. Since 2026-10-02 the panel unpacks its bundled files through the host FileSystem with no shell, so it can run on Windows; not yet run on a Windows machine.
